text:
mike: pushed a first-pass dashboard for batcher utilization + queue health, looking for quick eyes before I add alerts https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/xyz/batcher-util
sophia: nice, saw the panels. what sampling window are you using for token/sec? looks spiky
mike: default 1m rate right now, can do 5m smoothing if folks prefer. main goal is to correlate token/sec drops with batch formation failures
raj: can we add kv_cache_hitrate per-node? the last regression we investigated looked driven by KV churn, not queueing
liz: agree. here's a promql for per-node kv hitrate:
```
sum(rate(kv_cache_hits_total{job="batcher"}[5m])) by (instance) /
sum(rate(kv_cache_requests_total{job="batcher"}[5m])) by (instance)
```
mike: great, I'll add that as a small table. also added a panel for avg_batch_utilization (tokens_in_batch / batch_capacity)
raj: noticed one oddity: after the kernel-change rollout last week, batch_util dropped ~15% at p95 latency windows. attaching the tiny flame snippet I grabbed
liz: please paste the kernel selection profile lines here
raj: `kernel_selector.cpp:line 312 choose_kernel_for_shape() -> selected cuFFT32 (fallback) cost=1.8x expected=1.0x` — caused extra copies for odd sequence lengths
sophia: we should annotate the dashboard with the kernel rollout time so infra teams can correlate
mike: good call. I'll add an annotation layer and a small note about the rollback window
ci-bot: deploy/monitor: grafana/dashboard/batcher-util v1 -> deployed by mike at 2024-05-12T18:27:45Z :rocket:
liz: alert ideas: page at avg_queue_depth > 200 for 2m OR token/sec drop > 40% vs baseline for 3m. add KV hitrate drop alert too (< 75% for 5m)
sophia: also add a non-paging slack alert at warning for batch_util < 0.6 for 5m so SRE can investigate before paging
mike: will add those. question for product: do we want to instrument per-customer token_budget_target vs actual consumption? helps debug noisy tenants
raj: yes, especially for Dedicated; noisy tenant throttling often looks like queue pressure in graphs but it is actually token_budget exhaustion
mike: ok, adding a per-tenant breakdown panel (top 10 by tokens/sec) and a single-tenant drilldown link
liz: one perf note: the profiler showed heavy serialize/deser in request metadata path when batch sizes > 256, that bakes into queue time — we should sample request sizes in a histogram
sophia: add 99th percentile of enqueue_time and a histogram for batch_size. good quick signal for when we hit pathological input distributions
mike: timeline: I'll push v1 alerts + annotations by EOD, add KV hitrate + per-tenant panels tomorrow, then a canary rollout to 10% traffic Friday
raj: if we see the kernel fallback pattern again we should auto-fallback to previous kernel for affected shapes
mike: noted — will open a small RFC for auto-fallback policy and link it in the dashboard notes
sophia: LGTM for initial rollout. Mike, ping when alerts are live and we'll run a synthetic load test
mike: will do, thanks all :thumbsup:
